channel.desc: It's the series finale, and the teams must race from Medell?n, Colombia's second-largest city, in an epic push of over 1,000km to the finish line on the Guajira Peninsula, the northernmost region of South America. They can either cut a course inland or follow the tourist trail along the Caribbean coast. After 33 days and nearly 5,900km, which team will triumph and be the first to sign the all-important book and be crowned the winners?
